translations.web: The man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.
translations.bsb: Thus Jacob became exceedingly prosperous. He owned large flocks, maidservants and menservants, and camels and donkeys.
translations.kjv: And the man increased exceedingly, and had much cattle, and maidservants, and menservants, and camels, and asses.
translations.asv: And the man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, and maid-servants and men-servants, and camels and asses.
